topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I can't believe I just found out about this. A novel? Really? All this time, while I’ve been dealing with life, holding things down, he’s been off crafting some fictional version of me. I don’t know what’s worse, the idea of him spilling our most private moments onto pages or the fact that he felt the need to create a whole alternate reality. Wasn’t our life enough? Was it that boring, that he needed to exaggerate and rewrite it? I’m not sure what I’m supposed to do with this information, but I know one thing for sure: we need to talk, and it’s not going to be a pleasant conversation.
